rows.text: when byte `+3` of `rcx` AND `0xE0` equals `0x60`, takes the qword `+0xF0` of qword `+0xB8` of `rcx`, stores `xmm1` times float `01DFE0BC` (decoded 1.0) at its float `+0x2C` and `r8b` at its byte `+0x2B`; otherwise returns without work

builds the 16 bytes (`xmm1`, `xmm2`, `xmm3`, 1.0 from `01CEBBA8`) on the stack; when byte `+3` of `rcx` AND `0xE0` equals `0x60`, copies them to offsets `+0x00`..`+0x0C` of the qword `+0xF0` of qword `+0xB8` of `rcx` and zeroes its byte `+0x2A`; otherwise returns without storing
when `rcx` is non-null and byte `+3` of `rcx` AND `0xE0` equals `0x60`, stores `xmm1` at float `+0x20` of the qword `+0xF0` of qword `+0xB8` of `rcx`; otherwise returns without work

returns 0 unless `rcx` is non-null, qword `+0xC0` of `rcx` is non-null, the dword at that pointer is not -1, its low word is not -1, the row qword `022C6F28` plus the sign-extended word times `0x740` is non-null, dword `+0x284` of that row is non-zero and `003E6AF0` (with `rcx` = the row) returns non-zero; then returns 1 when `002EA910(rcx)` returns 1 and 0 otherwise (`sete`)
